results.description: Warm all-suite hotel with 2 restaurants. Relaxed suites in a casual hotel offering 2 restaurants & a bar, plus free breakfast & parking.
features: On a bustling city street, this warm all-suite hotel facing Cariappa Memorial Park is a 6-minute walk from the nearest metro station and 9 km from shops at Central Mall.

Relaxed suites, some with city views, offer free Wi=Fi, flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemaking equipment, plus living rooms, safes, balconies, and en suite, shower-only bathrooms. Upgraded suites add another balcony.
Parking is free, as is breakfast. There are 2 restaurants, 1 of which serves Thai and South Asian cuisine. There’s also a vibrant bar with a patio overlooking the park. Event space is available.
